## Quick start

Enable the `swift-app-store` plugin in Antigravity Customizations (or copy
`skills/appstore-review` into your project's `.agents/skills/` directory).

Then from your iOS project workspace, ask the agent to run an App Store review
audit with `appstore-review`:

```
Run the appstore-review audit on this iOS project.
```

For full setup instructions — including how to configure project rules in
`AGENTS.md` / `GEMINI.md`, add a standing checklist, and what output to expect
— see the [Setup & Usage Guide](references/setup-guide.md).

## 1. Install the skill

### Option A: Install script

```bash
git clone https://github.com/3paws-ai/mobile-ai-skills.git
cd mobile-ai-skills
./scripts/install.sh appstore-review
```

This copies the skill to `~/.claude/skills/appstore-review/`.

### Option B: Manual copy

```bash
cp -R skills/appstore-review ~/.claude/skills/appstore-review
```

### Verify installation

After installing, confirm these files exist:

```
~/.claude/skills/appstore-review/
  SKILL.md
  references/
    appstore-review-ref.md
    setup-guide.md
```

## 1. Install the skill

### Option A: Antigravity plugin (recommended)

Enable the `swift-app-store` plugin in Antigravity Customizations. The skill is
discovered automatically whenever the plugin is enabled.

### Option B: Manual copy (workspace or global)

```bash
cp -R skills/appstore-review .agents/skills/appstore-review
# or globally: cp -R skills/appstore-review ~/.gemini/config/skills/appstore-review
```

### Verify installation

After installing standalone, confirm these files exist:

```
~/.gemini/config/skills/appstore-review/
  SKILL.md
  references/
    appstore-review-ref.md
    setup-guide.md
```

rewrites.find:
## 2. Register the skill in your CLAUDE.md

For Claude Code to know about the skill, add it to your `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`
(global) or your project's `CLAUDE.md`. Add an entry to your skills table:

```markdown
## Skills

| Task | Skill to read |
|---|---|
| App Store review readiness audit | `~/.claude/skills/appstore-review/SKILL.md` |
```

This tells the agent where to find the skill when invoked.

## 2. Automatic discovery and project rules (`AGENTS.md` / `GEMINI.md`)

Antigravity automatically discovers skills inside an enabled plugin,
`.agents/skills/`, or `~/.gemini/config/skills/`. Optionally, add a pointer
in your `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md` or project `AGENTS.md` / `GEMINI.md`:

```markdown
## Skills

| Task | Skill to read |
|---|---|
| App Store review readiness audit | `appstore-review` (`SKILL.md`) |
```

This reinforces when the agent should invoke the skill.
